title: Google Ads Access & Campaign Optimisation
alertDesc: Invitation received but Standard access required to optimise campaigns
detailTitle: Getting Standard access to review and optimise the Google Ads account
detailBody:
The Google Ads invitation was sent but is currently read-only — meaning campaigns, spend history, audience data, and bidding strategies can be seen but nothing can be changed.

Standard access needs to be granted so a full audit can be done and optimisations applied directly inside the account.
benefitTitle: Every dirham spent improves — without increasing the budget
benefitBody:
Right now the Google Ads budget runs without expert oversight. With Standard access, every campaign can be audited for wasted spend, underperforming keywords identified, and bidding strategies adjusted.

The result: better leads at lower cost per click, and a clear picture of what's actually driving enquiries vs. burning budget.
blocker: Google Ads → Admin → Access & Security → find the invited email → change role from Read Only to Standard

title: Website User Behaviour — WordPress + Correct GTM
alertDesc: Correct GTM container and WordPress login needed to analyse user behaviour
detailTitle: Analysing how visitors move through the Dluxe website
detailBody:
Access is needed to WordPress (editor or admin) and the correct Google Tag Manager container — GTM-N8GMVMW4 — which has live tracking history.

Note: GTM-56X728BG was created 3 days ago and has no data — it is not useful for this analysis.
benefitTitle: Turn more website visitors into paying customers
benefitBody:
Once tracking is reviewed, it becomes clear exactly where visitors drop off, which pages convert, and what happens before someone submits a WhatsApp or enquiry lead.

This means improvements can be made to the right pages — boosting conversions without spending more on ads.
blocker:
Google Tag Manager → Admin → User Management → add access to GTM-N8GMVMW4 only
WordPress → add as Editor or Administrator

title: WhatsApp Lead Channel — Conflict Resolution
detailTitle: Fixing the WhatsApp account conflict blocking the lead channel
detailBody:
The error 'This account cannot be used on WhatsApp Business' is caused by the same number being active on 4 desktop web sessions and 1 WhatsApp Business mobile device simultaneously — violating WhatsApp's multi-device policy.

Three routes are being investigated to resolve this cleanly and sustainably.
benefitTitle: Restore and upgrade the most direct lead channel
benefitBody:
WhatsApp is one of Dluxe's primary inbound channels. Every day the conflict is unresolved, leads land on a broken or unresponsive experience — directly costing enquiries and revenue.

Fixing this also opens the path to WhatsApp Business API via a BSP (Interakt / WATI / 360dialog), enabling multiple agents to handle leads from one number — professionally and at scale.
blocker:
1. Log out all linked devices → WhatsApp Web → ⋮ → Linked Devices → remove all → reconnect from one primary device
2. Migrate to WhatsApp Business API (Interakt / WATI / 360dialog) — multi-agent on one number
3. Dedicated second number if community features need to stay separate
